[D] Controller edits / agent access
|-- MappingDocumentController
|   |-- getSnapshot / nodes / subscribe
|   |-- applyUpdate(expectedVersion, operations)
|   |   |-- transact = same path for MCP batches
|   |   |-- require matching version + 1..100 operations
|   |   |-- clone document/canvas; stage operations in order
|   |   |-- content: create / insert / replace / patchDiagram
|   |   |-- metadata: setSourceMappings / setJumps
|   |   |-- revision: diagram-revision-apply
|   |   |   `-- expectedRevisionId + receiveDiagramRevision
|   |   |-- edges: edge-create / edge-update / edge-remove
|   |   |-- grid: move / collapse / group / remove
|   |   |-- subtree collapse -> diagramViews revision + node IDs
|   |   |-- floating: pixel move / collapse / remove
|   |   |-- delete-diagrams -> prune content, selection, panes
|   |   `-- validate/project -> one recorded updateSnapshot
|   |-- edits -> DiagramService; track node correspondence
|   |   `-- patch rebases edges, jumps, folds, section lines
|   |-- recorded update -> reconcile + validate connections
|   |   `-- normalize views / layout -> history.append -> notify
|   |-- select(command) -> recorded SelectionState update
|   `-- updateCanvas defaults transient; undo/reset use history
`-- useAgentCanvasBridge + MappingPage.handleAgentCommand
    |-- canvasId: ephemeral; stableWorkspaceId: browser identity
    |-- POST registration; poll commands; POST replies
    |-- context -> version, name, nodes, edges
    |-- document-state -> document, name
    |-- snapshot -> controller snapshot + history + saved IDs
    |-- apply -> request receipt + controller.applyUpdate
    |-- apply-diagram-revision -> receiver + persistence flush
    |-- copy-document / create-document -> workspace drafts
    |-- retry command IDs -> cached mutation results
    |   `-- context stays fresh; receipt cache capped at 200
    |-- live selections -> WebSocket /api/mapping/live
    `-- cleanup/pagehide -> unregister ephemeral canvas
